task: Follow-up review for RSP-24 after addressing first-round concerns.
user_intent: Norven requires RedCap to stop relying on isolated E2E success, isolated command success, or self-referential evidence as proof of runtime stability. RSP-24 must show independent runtime-health validation within its own scope.
main_claim: RSP-24 first-round Prism concerns have been accepted and addressed within RSP-24 scope by adding an external-to-checker independent probe, a 7×5 injected failure matrix, provider_unavailable degraded validation, regenerated evidence, and updated receipts.
changed_reality: Updated runtime/core/cap_runtime_health.py so the main RSP-24 report references independent_cross_validation when present.
Regenerated RSP-24 check receipts including runtime-health-independent-probe.

accepted_concerns.minimum_fix: Provide independent, reproducible evidence that injects representative failures and asserts classification, especially failed entrypoint aggregation and provider_unavailable degradation.
Run an external-to-checker verification process that observes the same seven entrypoints without sharing cap_runtime_health.py code path, and confirm agreement or report discrepancy.

evidence.summary: Independent observer that does not import cap_runtime_health.py; it runs the seven entrypoint commands and builds a 7×5 injected failure matrix.
Independent probe output: ok=true, entrypoint_count=7, matrix_size=35, matrix_passed=true, provider_unavailable_policy=degraded.
Main RSP-24 evidence now includes independent_cross_validation ok=true and path to the independent probe.
Receipt for the independent probe execution.
RSP-24 scoped contract check still passes after the independent probe addition.

review_question: Do the new external probe, 7×5 failure matrix, provider_unavailable degraded assertion, and regenerated evidence close your first-round concern within the RSP-24 scope? If not, provide a concrete minimum fix without expanding into full RedCap revival.
known_constraints: Do not claim RedCap 完整复活.
If still concern/block, identify the exact missing runtime evidence or code change.
